verdict.rationale: Streaming and latency behavior is a fair axis for an LLM model family and its official tooling, so the story applies. However, nothing in the pack documents token-by-token streaming, sub-second response times, or any published latency behavior. The closest items are a vague 'agent-optimized inference' claim and an anecdotal 'fast' impression of the Meta Chat UI, and neither delivers the story.
